hero.intro: Crowi v2 is back in active development under the codename

about.title: About Crowi
about.description: Crowi is an open-source Markdown-based wiki application. Originally released in 2014, it's built so teams can share what they know.

items.title: Brand-new frontend
items.description: Express + Swig + jQuery is out. Next.js (App Router) + React + Tailwind is in — built for the modern web.

items.title: API-first
items.description: Server and view fully separated. A type-safe ts-rest contract makes Crowi programmable from anywhere.

items.title: Compatible with v1 data
items.description: A clean migration path keeps everything your team has already written. No knowledge left behind.

items.title: Modern runtime
items.description: Node.js 22.x, MongoDB, Redis, optional Elasticsearch — plus pluggable storage, search, and auth.

status.title: Where we are
status.description: Active development on main. Core features (page CRUD / list / history / comments / notifications / bookmarks / likes / trash / backlinks / user pages) have all migrated to the new stack. Admin section and search are next.
